meta.title: Shohojatri
meta.description: From the first worry to the long journey — always beside your child

landing.promise: From the first worry to the long journey — always beside your child

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to your account.
login.forgotHelp: Contact the Shohojatri team. They'll give you a temporary password, which you then replace with your own.
login.specialistNote: Specialist? Log in with the temporary password Shohojatri sent you.

role.title: How are you joining?
role.subtitle: We'll set up the app around your role.
role.parentDescription: Understand and support your own child's growth
role.teacherDescription: Share your students' progress with their families
role.specialistAnswer: Your account is created by Shohojatri.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Just three details — under a minute.
signup.name: Your name
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a number

setPassword.title: Set a new password
setPassword.subtitle: It's your first login — replace the temporary password with your own.

validation.email: That email address doesn't look right.
validation.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters, including a number.
validation.contactRequired: Add an email or a mobile number — at least one.

parent.next: Soon you'll be able to start your child's screening and see their profile here.

teacher.next: Soon you'll be able to ask a parent for access here, using their child's ID.

specialist.next: Soon the children you see will be listed here, and you'll be able to request access with a Child ID.

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.subtitle: Doctors and therapists on Shohojatri. Their accounts can only be created here.
specialists.emptyMessage: Add the first specialist — a temporary password will be created for them.
specialists.resetConfirm: {name}'s current password will stop working, and they'll be logged out on every device.

reveal.title: Temporary password for {name}
reveal.warning: This is shown only now — it can't be shown again. Give it to them in person or by phone. They'll set their own password at first login.

create.title: Add a specialist
create.subtitle: The account will show as verified. Only add someone after checking their registration number.
create.name: Full name
create.registrationHint: BMDC or relevant professional body number
create.contactHint: An email or mobile number to log in with — at least one.
